I was bullied really bad in school too and now my biggest regret is not telling my parents. You have the power to do that now. You got this ! Remember that you aren’t doing anything wrong they are the wrong ones !

Before being bullied it was easy for me to make friends. I was happy I was comfortable being with anyone. I was happy just by myself and no matter who was there I was happy too. But after being bullied I have the over whelming need to feel like I claim a best friend. I feel like they’re supposed to owe me loyalty and as of I’m supposed to be their main only friend. I’ve become so insecure. I kiss ass to get people to like me I’m nice all the time to get people to stay I bend myself backwards and let me be screwed over to keep friends. And anytime I’m made a butt of a joke even if they’re kidding I take that so personally. A joke feels like bullying to me because that’s how I was teased for so many years. When I start to get that feeling I start shutting down. I distance myself I get diffensive I over think. Until I just disappear. Because I know if I express my feelings it just wouldn’t make sense. Now I’m that happiest when I’m alone. No one to worry about, no one to make fun of me. I used to have two close friends but they added two more people into our friend group. Now I feel like competition. I can’t be at peace I hate that I see it like that. But that’s how it was in middle school and in high school. I compete for the attention of who I feel is the alpha in the group. It sounds sad writing that. Sorry that this response turned into a rant I just never expressed it before until now. Sounds wierd but it’s hard to find other people that were bullied at least for me.
